text: Security is essential in web development. When you build a website, you must protect both your users and your data. First, always use HTTPS to encrypt information between the browser and the server. This keeps passwords and personal details safe from attackers. Second, use strong authentication, such as complex passwords and two-factor verification, to confirm who users really are. Third, validate all input carefully, because common vulnerabilities like SQL injection and cross-site scripting often start with unchecked data. By following these basic practices, developers can reduce risks and create safer websites for everyone.
